summary: Steel lookout tower in Alachua County, erected 1953; sold at auction in 1996 for $557 and taken down in 1997. No source names its new home or describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Taken down in 1997; no source describes what remains at the site.

events.note: Steel lookout tower erected; the Forest Lookouts page gives only the year
Sold at auction in October 1996; went for $557 to the highest of four bidders
Taken down in March 1997; top 60 feet lowered by crane and prepared for a move to a new home

notes_for_editor: One detailed source for the tower's history (Forest Lookouts). Nothing we read names the new home the top section was readied for, and no source describes the original site today. Record coordinates come from the Forest Lookouts list and are unverified. Wikipedia is used only for town context. Record status 'gone' fits the sources, so no correction proposed.
